applicability: any working-tree read standing in for a named revision, including single-branch repositories where a dirty tree diverges from a matching HEAD; excludes reads already bound to the revision itself, such as git show <rev>:<path> or an immutable export
destination: AGENTS.md One writer per checkout (confirm the base before reading it)

evidence.source_reference: PR #119 be1bd0b builder session reading a parked shared checkout

expected_behavior: Before reading a working tree as a named base, confirm git rev-parse HEAD is that base AND the tree is clean for the paths being read -- a matching HEAD over staged, unstaged, or untracked changes still yields bytes the revision does not contain, and a default git status --porcelain omits ignored files, so a clean report does not cover an ignored path a reader may still consume. Where the target may be ignored, or either check is unavailable, read blobs from the revision itself with git show <rev>:<path>.
observation: A builder read repository bytes off a shared checkout parked on an unrelated branch and treated them as its assigned base. An import present only on the parked branch was assumed present on the base; the resulting NameError was caught by the builder's own mutation proof rather than by any gate.
reason: Second occurrence of the class; the first (an adversarial review that followed a dirty nested worktree and reviewed the wrong branch) is in operator memory. The clean-tree half was added at review: HEAD identity alone is not byte identity, and that holds in a single-branch repository too.
